One visible difference, as asked: Text("\(Int)%") went through LocalizedStringKey, which formats Int interpolation with the locale's grouping, so 1000% showed as '1,000%' (or '1.000%'). Text(String) is verbatim and now shows '1000%'. This only appears at 1000% or more. It now matches the NSStatusItem, tooltip and notification strings, which never grouped, so I accept it and do not require a change. No contract changes.
